manifest.labels: Consecutive user durations from first saved frame; transitions excluded; primary 2s trims with 1s sensitivity. No fitted offset. Labeled end 261.83s; later tail unlabeled.

scene.operator: stationary at B, described as away from sensor range, during every quiet hold; user explicitly confirmed
scene.dimensions_provenance: Inherited prior same-box setup; not remeasured in this message
scene.distance_reference: Antenna face to box front surface from established protocol; latest message gives nominal placements
scene.background_wall: Prior setup a little over 2 m; latest message did not remeasure

capture_metadata.label: live
capture_metadata.firmware_identity: unknown; profile ID is not a firmware hash
capture_metadata.freshness: relative timing only; no firmware handshake

clock_sync.limitation: Relative progress only; no absolute age handshake; startup latency ramps can resemble clock skew

detector.measurement: Confirmed current CFAR local maxima only; native bins; no held or predicted distance
detector.input: Full RD power; zero Doppler retained; no empty/background subtraction
detector.nominal_distance: Native RD bin centers retained beside experimental uncalibrated refinements
detector.identity: Radar feature hypotheses, not certified object identities or obstacle decisions
detector.freshness: Live stream continuity, host clock, backlog and timeout gates clear all hypotheses
detector.primary_policy: Exact frozen 1D baseline; no automatic RD-only promotion
detector.refinement: Current dense range FFT then slow-time Hann FFT; three Doppler rows; native half-bin range support; competing nearby peaks withheld
detector.evidence: 1D and RD share ADC data; source agreement is not independent confirmation

experimental_os.confirmation: overlapping group support; maximum moves at most one bin per frame
experimental_os.edge_policy: truncate; require minimum total reference count
experimental_os.threshold_interpretation: Empirical multiplier; no calibrated Pfa; not interchangeable with CA statistics

detector.motion_policy: v2: two consecutive same-sign confirmed RD motion measurements; stopped continuation requires current CA threshold and local-peak support; no held/predicted range

receiver_diagnostics.scope: Confirmed current 1D group, raw chirps across Doppler; inspection only
receiver_diagnostics.interpretation: RX peaks share scene/data; agreement is not accuracy or identity. Residual at pooled FFT range includes other returns and peak bias, not a fitted confidence.

experimental_weak_candidate.scope: One confirmed OS group, resolved OS fine peak, unique current raw RD maximum, interior raw-tone optimum and two RX frequency optima nearby
experimental_weak_candidate.interpretation: Inspection only; geometry checks do not accept the phase range model. Global residual/model rejection stays visible. Existing OS FFT estimate is not calibrated target identity.

phase_estimator.model: Independent DC/cos/sin per chirp/RX; shared fast-time frequency; no window, baseline or label fit
phase_estimator.support: Current accepted group half-bin boundaries only; no expansion across a boundary optimum
phase_estimator.interpretation: Experimental estimator, empirical quality gates; not a detector or calibrated uncertainty

experimental_weak_motion_link.scope: Supplement only: same current confirmed RD feature after two same-sign measured motion frames; stopped OS/raw-peak support must identify its current peak
experimental_weak_motion_link.clearing: Invalid input, sequence gaps, missing/ambiguous/lost measurements, competitors or unsupported stops revoke the seed; stationary support cannot reseed
experimental_weak_motion_link.interpretation: Current RD fine inspection, no held/predicted range, primary eligibility or certified physical identity

experimental_weak_feature_confirmation.evidence: Confirmed OS + unique current RD maximum + original raw-peak geometry, then consecutive native-gated current observations; original RD birth margin is unchanged
experimental_weak_feature_confirmation.range_method: Existing current OS Hann FFT fine range, not a rejected phase estimate or Doppler-conditioned range
experimental_weak_feature_confirmation.interpretation: Separate weak: IDs denote scene-feature hypotheses, not objects; no primary eligibility, holding or prediction; shared ADC evidence is not independent confirmation

interpretation: New capture evaluated with unchanged settings; labels used only for scoring. Empty silence is inherited through gated stages and does not compensate for missing target ranges. Peak locations and spectral contrasts are diagnostics, not accepted physical target distances.
